ov: برج العذراء هو فيلم مصري عُرض عام 1970، من بطولة صلاح ذو الفقار وناهد شريف وعادل إمام ولبلبة ومن إخراج محمود ذو الفقار.
plotEn: Fahmy is an ardent believer in Astrology and horoscopes and manages his life according to them. A number of events increase his conviction, such as his promotion at work, which the horoscope predicts, the death of his uncle, and then his inheritance from him. An astrologer convinces him that his age is linked to a Virgo girl who has a black birthmark, which he is looking for. He discovers that she is Nana the fiancée of his friend Amin, so he tries to save her life. Nana and Ilham his wife agree on a plan to convince Fahmy of the mistake of relying on astrology.
